name: Fall of the Angels
source:
Elysium has been attacked by the Abyssal Queen, Zenera. Time is running short, as the Night of the Blood Moon is nearing ever closer. Our hero finds himself in a difficult situation: will he choose to leave Earth to find a way back home to free the Angels, his family, the only home he's ever known... or will he stay on Earth, defending those around him, those that have grown to care and love him, from the incoming threat?

[From [url=https://13th-sin-games.itch.io/fall-of-the-angels]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
极乐世界遭到深渊女王泽涅拉的攻击。时间已经不多了，血月之夜越来越近了。我们的英雄发现自己陷入了困境：他会选择离开地球，寻找回家的路，以释放天使、他的家人、他所知道的唯一家园……还是会留在地球上，保护他周围的人，那些已经成长为关心和爱他的人，免受即将到来的威胁？

[来自[url=https://13th-sin-games.itch.io/fall-of-the-angels]Itch.io[/url]]
